info.dm_sent: 📩 I sent you the duel guide in DM.
info.overview_desc: The duel system is built as a turn-based fight inspired by old-school JRPGs, think early Final Fantasy or Dragon Quest. RNG is part of the deal: damage rolls inside a range, but progression, stats, sabers and turn choices are there to offset that luck.
info.philosophy_value: Early on, a big damage roll can feel brutal. The higher your combat level, the wider your damage range gets, but it grows slower than your stat gains. The goal is to keep the JRPG DNA while leaving more and more room for preparation and good decisions.
info.progression_value: Winning a duel grants more combat XP and TookCoins, but losing still pays out. Levels grant stat points, and TookCoins buy new sabers. The `/duel fight nerf:True` mode gives a more balanced fight by ignoring levels and spent stats.
info.actions_desc: Every turn, both duelists choose an action without seeing what the other picked.
info.attack_value: Simple and reliable: deals damage based on your stats, your saber, any running bonuses and RNG.
info.parry_value: A defensive move on cooldown. If your opponent attacks, the parry can throw the damage right back. It hits hard, so timing is everything.
info.defense_value: Lets you stall: if your opponent attacks, damage drops hard (-60%). Handy while waiting on a parry, a special or a mini-game.
info.special_defense_value:
Ready every **4 turns**. When it is up, the Defense button turns into **🛡️✨ Special Defense**. You pick a body zone to shield (left/right arm, left/right leg) **in secret**. If your opponent attacks or throws a low blow, they must pick a zone to hit (blind too).
• **Match** (same zone) → damage **cancelled** + opponent takes **-20% atk** for 2 turns.
• **Miss** → standard defense applies (-60% damage).
Does not trigger against parry/defense/special.
info.low_blow_value: If your opponent is parrying, the low blow shatters the parry and deals critical damage. If they are not parrying, it hurts less than a normal attack. A risky read.
info.special_value: Every saber has its own special. It hits hard but it is limited: some mini-games can recharge it.
info.bonuses_desc: Mini-games pop up at random during a fight. They add a layer of risk-taking: the winner walks away with an edge that can flip the pace of the duel.
info.rewards_value:
- Recover 80 HP
- Special recharged
- +30% damage for 2 turns
- Recover 60 HP
- Parry recharged + a small HP top-up
info.why_luck_value: The system owns its randomness to recapture the tension of old JRPGs. The idea is not that every turn is perfectly predictable, but that progression, sabers, cooldowns and mini-games hand you ways to take back control.
